19748-story-lives-of-great-musicians.description: A book by Francis Jameson Rowbotham. 'Christoph, I wish you would let me have that book of manuscript music which you have in your cupboard--the one which contains pieces by Pachelbel, and Frohberger, and Buxtehude, and ever so many others--you know which I mean. arxiv-2311-02245.creator: F. Aicardi

arxiv-2407-20463.title: 5G NR Positioning with OpenAirInterface: Tools and Methodologies
arxiv-2407-20463.creator: Rakesh Mundlamuri 1 2 , Rajeev Gangula 2 , Florian Kaltenberger 1 2 , and Raymond Knopp 1, 1 Communication Systems Department, EURECOM, Biot, France, 2 Institute for the Wireless Internet of Things, Northeastern University, Boston, USA
arxiv-2407-20463.description: Abstract The fifth-generation new radio (5G NR) technology is expected to provide precise and reliable positioning capabilities along with high data rates. The Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) has started introducing positioning techniques from Release-16 based on time, angle, and signal strength using reference signals. However, validating these techniques with experimental prototypes is crucial before successful real-world deployment.

arxiv-2410-00186.title: Fully upgraded β-NMR setup at ISOLDE for high-precision high-field studies
arxiv-2410-00186.creator: M. Jankowski, N. Azaryan, M. Baranowski, M. L. Bissell, H. Brand, M. Chojnacki, J. Croese, K. M. Dziubinska-Kühn, B. Karg, M. Madurga Flores, M. Myllymäki, M. Piersa-Silkowska, L. Vazquez Rodriguez, S. Warren, D. Zakoucky, M. Kowalska
arxiv-2410-00186.description: Abstract β-NMR is an advancing technique that enables measurements relevant to various fields of research, ranging from physics to chemistry and biology. Among the recent achievements of the β-NMR setup located at the ISOLDE facility at CERN is the determination of the magnetic moment of a short-lived nucleus with a part-per-million accuracy.

arxiv-2507-22327.title: Mean-Variance Optimization and Algorithm for Finite-Horizon Markov Decision Processes
arxiv-2507-22327.creator: Li Xia, Zhihui Yu, School of Business, Sun Yat-Sen University, Guangzhou, China
arxiv-2507-22327.description: Abstract Multi-period mean-variance optimization is a long-standing problem, caused by the failure of dynamic programming principle. This paper studies the mean-variance optimization in a setting of finite-horizon discrete-time Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the objective is to maximize the combined metrics of mean and variance of the accumulated rewards at terminal stage.

arxiv-2509-12887.title: Simple Vector Magnetometer Based on Ground State Hanle Effect
arxiv-2509-12887.creator: Nayan Sharma, Ranjit Kumar Singh, Ajay Tripathi
arxiv-2509-12887.description: Abstract We present a method for determining the azimuthal phase (angle) of a magnetic field by exploiting phase matching of laser beams in a ground-state Hanle effect (GHSE) configuration. This approach is based on the symmetry of the system’s Hamiltonian and the existence of a phase-independent frame, allowing for direct determination of the field orientation.

arxiv-2602-15815.title: Natural Privacy Filters Are Not Always Free: A Characterization of Free Natural Filters Thanks: Authors BH, EL, PM, and PT in alphabetical order.
arxiv-2602-15815.creator: Matthew Regehr, Bingshan Hu, Ethan Leeman, Pasin Manurangsi, Pierre Tholoniat, Mathias Lécuyer
arxiv-2602-15815.description: Abstract We study natural privacy filters, which enable the exact composition of differentially private (DP) mechanisms with adaptively chosen privacy characteristics. Earlier privacy filters consider only simple privacy parameters such as Rényi-DP or Gaussian DP parameters. Natural filters account for the entire privacy profile of every query, promising greater utility for a given privacy budget.

britannica-1911-monition.title: Monition (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-monition.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-monition.description: Article 'Monition' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. English ecclesiastical law, an order requiring or admonishing the person complained of to do something specified in the monition, or appear and show cause to the contrary, “under pain of the law and penalty thereof.” It is the lightest form of ecclesiastical censure, whether to clergymen or laymen, but disobedience to it, after it has been duly and regularly served, entails the penalties of contempt of court.

pmc-10647227.title: Heterogeneity of Phase II Enzyme Ligands on Controlling the Progression of Human Gastric Cancer Organoids as Stem Cell Therapy Model
pmc-10647227.creator: Deng-Chyang Wu, Chia-Chen Ku, Jia-Bin Pan, Kenly Wuputra, Ya-Han Yang, Chung-Jung Liu, Yi-Chang Liu, Kohsuke Kato, Shigeo Saito, Ying-Chu Lin, Inn-Wen Chong, Michael Hsiao, Huang-Ming Hu, Chao-Hung Kuo, Kung-Kai Kuo, Chang-Shen Lin, Kazunari K. Yokoyama
pmc-10647227.description: Gastric cancer (GC) organoids are frequently used to examine cell proliferation and death as well as cancer development. Invasion/migration assay, xenotransplantation, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) production were used to examine the effects of antioxidant drugs, including perillaldehyde (PEA), cinnamaldehyde (CA), and sulforaphane (SFN), on GC. PEA and CA repressed the proliferation of human GC organoids, whereas SFN enhanced it.

pmc-11337705.title: Gene panel predicts neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy response and benefit from immunotherapy in HER2-negative breast cancer
pmc-11337705.creator: Xunxi Lu, Zongchao Gou, Hong Chen, Li Li, Fei Chen, Chunjuan Bao, Hong Bu
pmc-11337705.description: BackgroundIt is encountering the dilemma of lacking precise biomarkers to predict the response to neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (NACI) and determine whether patients should use immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in early breast cancer (BC). We aimed to develop a gene signature to predict NACI response for BC patients and identify individuals suitable for adding ICIs.

pmc-11489059.title: Enhancing Air Quality Index Activity Guidelines for Preventing Cardiovascular Events in the General Adult Population
pmc-11489059.creator: Robert D Brook, Allison R Brook, Phillip D Levy, Steven Korzeniewski, Sadeer Al-Kindi, Sanjay Rajagopalan
pmc-11489059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe public health relevance of daily Air Quality Index (AQI) activity guidelines for the general adult public in the United States to prevent atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) events is questionable.ObjectivesThe purpose of the study was to explore the utility of a policy tailoring activity guidance to calculated ASCVD risk rather than uniform recommendations to the general adult public as currently provided.MethodsWe calculated the number needed to treat (NNT) to prevent one ASCVD event per day by following activity recommendations across 10-year ASCVD

pmc-11495195.title: Novel Dichloroacetophenone-Based PDHK1 Inhibitors as Potent Anticancer Agents
pmc-11495195.creator: Puhua Wu, Zhicheng Zhang, Yan Zhou, Quan Liu, Kin-Yip Tam, Zhenhong Su
pmc-11495195.description: BackgroundPyruvate dehydrogenase kinases (PDHKs), important metabolic and abnormally expressed enzymes in cancer cells, are promising targets for cancer therapy, especially for non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC).MethodsIn this study, a new hit, dichloroacetophenone (DAP) analog 9, was postulated to bind to the PDHK1 allosteric pocket, guided by molecular modeling and kinase biochemical experiments.

pmc-11530481.title: Computational Modelling of the Impact of Evaporation on In-Vitro Dermal Absorption
pmc-11530481.creator: Benjamin N Deacon, Samadhi Silva, Guoping Lian, Marina Evans, Tao Chen
pmc-11530481.description: PurposeVolatiles are common in personal care products and dermatological drugs. Determining the impact of evaporation of volatiles on skin permeation is crucial to evaluate and understand their delivery, bioavailability, efficacy and safety. We aim to develop an in-silico model to simulate the impact of evaporation on the dermal absorption of volatiles.

pmc-12518123.title: AAV-mediated MUC5AC siRNA delivery to prevent mucociliary dysfunction in asthma
pmc-12518123.creator: Sahana Kumar, Maria Corkran, Yahya Cheema, Margaret A Scull, Gregg A Duncan
pmc-12518123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The main structural components of mucus produced in the lung are mucin 5B (MUC5B) and mucin 5AC (MUC5AC) where a relatively higher expression of MUC5B is typical in health. In the lungs of individuals with asthma, there is a shift from MUC5B to MUC5AC as the predominantly secreted mucin which has been shown to impair mucociliary clearance (MCC) and increase airway mucus plug formation.

pmc-12550109.title: Point-of-care ultrasound (PoCUS) in the rapid diagnosis of biliary ileus: A case report
pmc-12550109.creator: Thomas Fraccalini, Alessandro Maraschi, Rossella Reddavid, Massimo Rizzo, Fabio Perotto, Luciano Cardinale
pmc-12550109.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-12606424.title: Mutant allele formation and inheritance during Cas9/guide RNA-mediated gene drive in a population modification mosquito strain for human malaria control
pmc-12606424.creator: Rebeca Carballar-Lejarazú, Thai Binh Pham, Taylor Tushar, Anthony A James
pmc-12606424.description: Gene-drive systems are under development for the population modification of anopheline vectors of human malaria parasites. The key to their success is the fixation of genes in target mosquito populations that encode molecules preventing parasite transmission. High-efficiency Cas9/guide RNA (gRNA)-based gene-drive systems can facilitate this objective.

pmc-12611745.title: Editorial: Infections in the intensive care unit, volume III
pmc-12611745.creator: Cheng Zhu, Bin Lin, Zhongheng Zhang, Yuetian Yu
pmc-12611745.description: ical resources to improve patient outcomes. Since 2023, our team has been preparing a Research Topic on “Infections in the ICU,” aiming to share advancements in both clinical and basic research in this field, with the goal of transforming clinical perspectives and translating these insights into actionable practices that can improve patient prognosis (1).

pmc-12691143.title: Nationwide Temporal Dynamics of Mammal Communities Across South Korea: Dominance Shifts and Predator—Prey Implications
pmc-12691143.creator: Taewoo Yi, Tae Gwan Kim, Bae Keun Lee, Sol Park, Jongchul Park, Junseok Lee, Chris R Pavey
pmc-12691143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryThis study analyzed long-term changes in mammal communities across the Korean Peninsula using data from the 3rd (2006–2013), 4th (2014–2018), and 5th (2019–2023) National Ecosystem Surveys. Results showed that a few adaptable species—particularly the water deer (Hydropotes inermis) and wild boar (Sus scrofa)—have become increasingly dominant, while smaller or specialist species such as the Korean hare (Lepus coreanus) have declined.

pmc-12711944.title: Big data analytics platform enhances teaching abilities in normal university students through triple helix collaboration
pmc-12711944.creator: Juan Zhao, Zhongjun Hu
pmc-12711944.description: Normal university students face significant challenges in developing comprehensive teaching competencies due to the lack of data-driven feedback and systematic assessment mechanisms in traditional teacher education programs. This research develops and validates an educational practice big data analysis platform guided by Triple Helix theory, which systematically integrates university pedagogical expertise, industry technological capabilities, and governmental educational standards.

pmc-13146284.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1445 PROGRESSION AND REGRESSION OF ASYMPTOMATIC CAROTID STENOSIS IN A MULTICENTER KOREAN REGISTRY (K-ACAS)
pmc-13146284.creator: Han-Yeong Jeong, Hyung-Min Kwon, Keun-Hwa Jung, Sungwook Yu, Kyusik Kang, Ji Man Hong, Sang Beom Kim, Yang-Ha Hwang, Jun Hong Lee, Eung-Gyu Kim, Jay Chol Choi, Seung-Jae Lee, Park Jong-Ho, Yong-Jae Kim, Yongseok Lee
pmc-13146284.description: Background and aimsThe natural history of asymptomatic carotid stenosis (ACS) under contemporary medical therapy remains incompletely defined, particularly regarding ultrasonographic progression and regression. This study aimed to quantify the rates and determinants of carotid stenosis progression and regression in patients with ACS and to explore their association with short-term vascular events.

pmc-13471753.title: Effects of Bleaching Protocols on the Esthetic Outcome and Surface Integrity of Enamel Treated With an Ammonia‐Free Silver Fluoride Solution
pmc-13471753.creator: Ahmed Alshawi, Fadimeana Lal, Esra Yildiz, Sevda Ozel Yildiz, Ugur Erdemir
pmc-13471753.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveTo investigate the effects of three bleaching protocols on the color stability and surface roughness of enamel previously treated with a water‐based, ammonia‐free silver fluoride solution (Riva Star Aqua).Materials and MethodsEighty‐eight human enamel/dentin specimens were demineralized and treated with Riva Star Aqua, divided into four groups (n = 22): Control (no bleaching), home bleaching with 15% hydrogen peroxide (HP), in‐office bleaching with 40% HP, and laser‐activated bleaching with 46% HP.

pmc-13566462.title: Comparative Analysis of Chloroplast Genomes Reveals Molecular Evolution and Phylogenetic Relationships in Fraxinus (Fraxinus mandshurica)
pmc-13566462.creator: Wenxuan Liu, Jiawei Wu, Haonan Zheng, Guanzheng Qu, Sui Wang
pmc-13566462.description: Fraxinus mandshurica (Manchurian ash) is an ecologically and economically valuable hardwood tree native to Northeast Asia, yet its genomic resources remain limited. We assembled its complete chloroplast (cp) genome (155,559 bp) using hybrid PacBio and Illumina sequencing and performed comparative, phylogenetic, and evolutionary analyses.
